simple.meaning: כָּמַס (kâmaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to store away , i.e. (figuratively) in the memory.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Deuteronomy, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:34. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּמַס (H3647) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: כָּמַס (kâmaç) / H3647 is traced through Deuteronomy 32:34 with source-language evidence and verse context.
